verdict.rationale: Bruno CLI runs entire collections headlessly, generates JSON/JUnit/HTML test reports, and integrates with CI/CD pipelines, with hands-on verification the CLI installs and runs (bruno-probe-4). Docker images also support running collections in CI without Node install. Missing for 10: independent third-party report of a real pass/fail CI run with actual failing tests, and no community corroboration specifically of the test-report feature.
